label: The middle class becomes the new poor
description: A reordering in which the middle class becomes the new poor, the rich become the middle class and the poor are pushed further down, with Skid Row conditions stretching for miles across America. Given 28 December 2025.
aliases: middle class now will become the new poor

label: Great doors of opportunity open in South America
description: Favour with governments and great doors of opportunity opening across South America for missionary work. Given 26 December 2025.
aliases: doors of opportunity are coming in south america

label: A money tree with hundred dollar bills as its fruit
description: A tree seen bearing hundred dollar bills as fruit, ready to be taken. Given 23 December 2025.

label: Revival from Minnesota to the Gulf, from sea to sea
description: A major revival coming to America running from Minnesota to the Gulf and from sea to sea, with pillars of revival seen. Given 22 December 2025.

label: The Chinese flag crumpled in a fist
description: The old communist Chinese flag with the stars seen taken down and crushed into a ball in a fist. Given 22 December 2025.
aliases: wadded it up in a ball
